name.ja: イグナーツ・ゼンメルワイス

overview.en: Ignaz Semmelweis was a Hungarian physician who discovered that handwashing by doctors dramatically reduced the incidence of childbed fever, pioneering antiseptic medicine.

early_life.en: Born in Buda to a German-speaking family, he studied medicine in Vienna and became an assistant at the Vienna General Hospital's maternity clinic.

impact.en: His discovery that hand disinfection could prevent puerperal fever saved countless lives, though his ideas were rejected during his lifetime in one of medicine's greatest tragedies.

event.en: Introduced mandatory handwashing with chlorinated lime at the Vienna maternity clinic
Published data showing dramatic reduction in maternal mortality
Published The Etiology, Concept, and Prophylaxis of Childbed Fever

title.en: The Etiology, Concept, and Prophylaxis of Childbed Fever

description.en: Book documenting his evidence for hand disinfection in preventing puerperal fever

text.en: When I look back upon the past, I can only dispel the sadness which falls upon me by gazing into that happy future when the infection will be banished.

quotes.source: The Etiology, Concept, and Prophylaxis of Childbed Fever
